newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says starts 10th Chinese venture.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says starts 10th Chinese venture.

text.p: German chemicals group Bayer AG said on Monday it has founded its 10th joint venture in China to develop polyurethanes with a unit of China's National Petrochemical Corp.

Bayer said it signed the deal with Jinling Petrochemical Corp (JCP). Bayer will own 55 percent of the joint venture, which will be called Bayer Jinling Polyurethane Co, while JCP will hold 45 percent.
The two companies plan to begin production this year on a plant that will produce 10,000 tonnes of polyurethanes on an annual basis. Output will begin later this week.
Total investment in the project, which will produce products for use in construction and automobile manufacturing, was seen at $10 million. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
